# What does this PR do?

This PR adds initial XingChen4 model support to LLaMA-Factory.
Before：feat: add TeleChat4 model support.

## Changes

- Add initial XingChen4 model support to LLaMA-Factory.
- Add XingChen4 chat template and model registration.
- Add XingChen4-specific model loading and compatibility logic.
- Extend model configuration and model engine handling for XingChen4.
- Update the English and Chinese README documentation to include XingChen4 support.

## Testing

- Successfully completed XingChen4 LoRA fine-tuning with the modified LLaMA-Factory codebase.
- The fine-tuning process completed successfully using a XingChen4 LoRA training configuration.
- Verified model loading, chat template handling, and LoRA fine-tuning integration.

## Before submitting

- [ ] Did you read the [contributor guideline](https://github.com/hiyouga/LLaMA-Factory/blob/main/.github/CONTRIBUTING.md)?
yes
- [ ] Did you write any new necessary tests?
The implementation has been functionally validated through an end-to-end XingChen4 LoRA fine-tuning run. No additional automated test cases have been introduced in this PR.

+@dataclass
+class Xing4ReasoningTemplate(ReasoningTemplate):
+    r"""Xing4.0 places the thinking-mode marker in the generation prompt."""
+
+    @override
+    def add_thought(self, content: str = "") -> str:
+        if not self.enable_thinking:
+            return self.thought_words[1] + content
+
+        return self.thought_words[0] + "\n" + self.thought_words[1] + content
+
+    def _move_thought_prefix(
+        self,
+        tokenizer: "PreTrainedTokenizer",
+        prompt_ids: list[int],
+        response_ids: list[int],
+    ) -> tuple[list[int], list[int]]:
+        if not self.enable_thinking:
+            return prompt_ids, response_ids
+
+        thought_prefix_ids = tokenizer.encode(self.thought_words[0], add_special_tokens=False)
+        if response_ids[: len(thought_prefix_ids)] == thought_prefix_ids:
+            prompt_ids += thought_prefix_ids
+            response_ids = response_ids[len(thought_prefix_ids) :]
+
+        return prompt_ids, response_ids
+
+    @override
+    def encode_oneturn(
+        self,
+        tokenizer: "PreTrainedTokenizer",
+        messages: list[dict[str, str]],
+        system: Optional[str] = None,
+        tools: Optional[str] = None,
+    ) -> tuple[list[int], list[int]]:
+        prompt_ids, response_ids = super().encode_oneturn(tokenizer, messages, system, tools)
+        return self._move_thought_prefix(tokenizer, prompt_ids, response_ids)
+
+    @override
+    def encode_multiturn(
+        self,
+        tokenizer: "PreTrainedTokenizer",
+        messages: list[dict[str, str]],
+        system: Optional[str] = None,
+        tools: Optional[str] = None,
+        discarding_history_cot: bool = False,
+    ) -> list[tuple[list[int], list[int]]]:
+        encoded_pairs = super().encode_multiturn(
+            tokenizer, messages, system, tools, discarding_history_cot=discarding_history_cot
+        )
+        return [
+            self._move_thought_prefix(tokenizer, prompt_ids, response_ids)
+            for prompt_ids, response_ids in encoded_pairs
+        ]
+

+class Xing4ToolUtils(ToolUtils):
+    r"""Xing4 tool using template."""
+
+    @override
+    @staticmethod
+    def tool_formatter(tools: list[dict[str, Any]]) -> str:
+        tool_text = "".join("\n" + json.dumps(tool, ensure_ascii=False) for tool in tools)
+        return XING4_TOOL_PROMPT.format(tool_text=tool_text)
+
+    @override
+    @staticmethod
+    def function_formatter(functions: list["FunctionCall"]) -> str:
+        calls = []
+        for name, arguments in functions:
+            if not isinstance(name, str) or not re.fullmatch(r"[^\s<>]+", name):
+                raise ValueError("Invalid xing4 function name.")
+
+            arguments = json.loads(arguments)
+            if not isinstance(arguments, dict):
+                raise ValueError("Xing4 function arguments must be a JSON object.")
+
+            call = f"<tool_call>{name}"
+            for key, value in arguments.items():
+                if not re.fullmatch(r"[^<>]+", key):
+                    raise ValueError("Invalid xing4 parameter name.")
+
+                value = value if isinstance(value, str) else json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False)
+                call += f"<param_key>{key}</param_key><param_value>{value}</param_value>"
+
+            calls.append(call + "</tool_call>")
+
+        return "".join(calls)
+
+    @override
+    @staticmethod
+    def tool_extractor(content: str) -> Union[str, list["FunctionCall"]]:
+        call_pattern = re.compile(r"<tool_call>(.*?)</tool_call>", re.DOTALL)
+        call_matches = list(re.finditer(call_pattern, content))
+        if not call_matches:
+            return content
+
+        if content.count("<tool_call>") != len(call_matches) or content.count("</tool_call>") != len(call_matches):
+            return content
+
+        results = []
+        param_pattern = re.compile(r"<param_key>(.*?)</param_key><param_value>(.*?)</param_value>", re.DOTALL)
+        for call_match in call_matches:
+            call_content = call_match.group(1)
+            name_match = re.match(r"\s*([^\s<>]+)", call_content)
+            if name_match is None:
+                return content
+
+            arguments = {}
+            params_content = call_content[name_match.end() :]
+            position = 0
+            for param_match in re.finditer(param_pattern, params_content):
+                if params_content[position : param_match.start()].strip():
+                    return content
+
+                key, raw_value = param_match.groups()
+                key = key.strip()
+                if not key:
+                    return content
+
+                try:
+                    value = json.loads(raw_value)
+                except json.JSONDecodeError:
+                    value = raw_value
+
+                arguments[key] = value
+                position = param_match.end()
+
+            if params_content[position:].strip():
+                return content
+
+            results.append(
+                FunctionCall(name_match.group(1), json.dumps(arguments, ensure_ascii=False))
+            )
+
+        return results
+
